record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare CRABHAMMER: CORPHISH (1 star), CRAWDAUNT (2 stars), POLIWRATH (3 stars); all have range 1 and maxPP 100 per the unit blocks. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (table index).
record.summary: Single-target hit on the cast target: SPECIAL damage of a raw 40/80/160 (by stars; AP-scaled) with a crit roll at the caster's crit chance + 30 points; if the target is below 30% of its max HP at cast time the hit becomes TRUE damage of a raw 9999 (an execute), which still takes AP and crit scaling.

targeting.note: No area; the strategy reads only the target's current and max HP.

effects.damageType: SPECIAL, or TRUE when the target is below 30% max HP
effects.scaling: requested = table value, or 9999 when target.hp / target.maxHP < 0.3 at cast time (then TRUE). applied by handleSpecialDamage: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost true by default, also for the 9999 case); x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite only for non-TRUE damage) if the re-rolled crit succeeded.
effects.resolution: SPECIAL branch: divided by 1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x SPE_DEF, flat reductions, at least 1 (rounded up). TRUE branch: no defence division, no flat reductions, at least 1. Shield absorbs before HP in both; protect / skydiving / magicBounce on the target block it entirely (magicBounce reflects SPECIAL only). takenDamage includes shield damage.

crit = chance((critChance + 30)/100, luck); the roll made in castAbility (canCritByDefault true) is discarded. Crit chance above 100 is converted to crit power elsewhere (addCritChance) so critChance stays at most 100; with the bonus the effective probability is capped at 1 by chance().

starBehavior.note: the table is indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value 320 is not reachable at the bare factory star counts of these units. The 30% threshold, 9999 execute and +30 crit chance do not vary by star. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None in this file beyond the cast range handled outside the strategy.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast reads the target's HP fraction at that moment.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 40/80/160 (1/2/3 stars) as SPECIAL, 9999 as TRUE below 30% target HP. Damage dealt = raw x (1 + AP/100) (x crit factor); SPECIAL is then divided by 1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x SPE_DEF with flat reductions and a minimum of 1; TRUE skips the defence division and flat reductions. Shield damage is included in takenDamage. None is computed here for a specific target.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after later modifiers in handleDamage (shields, items, resurrection, field multipliers); only the SPE_DEF division, the TRUE branch and the minimum of 1 were read
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution outside this file - only the roll in this strategy and the castAbility gate were read
unresolved: Whether the cast-time hp / maxHP check can see a different value than the damage call (they run in the same synchronous function, so no gap was found)
Death handling after a 9999 TRUE hit (resurrection effects, on-death effects) was not traced
Whether the three units ever reach a different star count than the factory value
No routing uncertainties were queued for this record
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
